International Weather Update  The Philippines Hit Hard by Typhoon Kalmaegi (TinoPH) 🌪️

Good morning everyone,

While we’ve been dodging the Cornish drizzle, over in the Philippines it’s a very different story. The big clean-up is now underway across parts of Cebu City, after powerful Typhoon Kalmaegi (locally named TinoPH) tore through the region, bringing howling winds, torrential rain, and devastating flooding.

Homes have been left caked in thick layers of mud, as shown in the video below. It’s hard to believe the sheer amount of silt and debris the storm left behind. Roads have turned into rivers, and many families are now working tirelessly to clear what’s left and start rebuilding their lives.

Kalmaegi is the latest in a series of storms to hit the western Pacific this season, reminding us how quickly tropical weather can turn destructive. The Philippines experiences around 20 typhoons a year, but even for a country well-prepared for storms, this one hit hard.

The local authorities and volunteers are out in full force helping communities recover, and thankfully, emergency response teams were quick to act saving many lives despite the destruction.

Our thoughts are with everyone affected by this powerful storm. ❤️

We’ll continue to share updates from the region as more information comes in.

Kind regards,
KWT Dave
☀️ Kernow Weather Team keeping an eye on the world’s weather, so you don’t have to!
